description: This file defines a Java interface `ThingCommand` which specifies common behaviors and constants for commands related to 'things' in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes method default implementations, nested classes for JSON field definitions, and references to various other components within the Ditto model.

classes.name: ThingCommand
classes.description: A generic interface representing commands related to a 'Thing' in the Eclipse Ditto model. It extends multiple interfaces to incorporate common command behaviors, entity typing, and identifying functionalities. Includes constants for command type prefix and resource type, as well as a nested class for JSON field definitions.

methods.name: getTypePrefix
methods.description: Returns the type prefix for Thing commands, combining a static string with a qualifier.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the 'Thing' entity ID associated with the command.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type associated with 'Thing' entities.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type, specifically the constant for 'Thing'.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the Ditto headers for the command.
